question: What are the design principles behind the Fern Ruby SDK?
ground_truth: The documentation for Ruby SDK design principles is currently a work in progress. Users should refer to the previous documentation at https://buildwithfern.com/learn/sdks/introduction/overview for information about SDK design principles and philosophy.
